api: GET https://ensani.ir/fa/article/search/index?term=<q>&searchType=0 (302 -> /fa/article?ArticleSearch[title]=<q>&ArticleSearch[sortBy]=relevance, server-rendered list); full text: GET https://ensani.ir/fa/article/download/<article_id> (302 -> /file/download/article/*.pdf)
name: Ensani — پرتال جامع علوم انسانی (Comprehensive Portal of Humanities, IHCS)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §34 (probe 2026-11-26): the portal of the Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies (پژوهشگاه علوم انسانی و مطالعات فرهنگی) — the largest Persian humanities article bank (hundreds of journals, hundreds of thousands of articles). Routes tried: (1) the site's own search form, GET /fa/article/search/index?term=<q>&searchType=0 — ANSWERS with real records (بیرونی -> 410 results; تاریخ علم -> 113; تاریخ نجوم -> 7; تاریخ ریاضیات -> 9), server-rendered list-view, no login; the search is portal-wide across ALL journals by default (no journal/subject filter applied), so its history-of-science titles are included. (2) Full text via the article page's own download route GET /fa/article/download/<id> -> 302 -> /file/download/article/*.pdf — probe-verified WITHOUT login or cookies: id 191665 (کتابشناسی بیرونی) -> 170,911 B, %PDF-1.4, 6 pages; id 475321 (مجلهٔ تاریخ علم، دوره ۱۹، ۱۴۰۰) -> 495,753 B, %PDF-1.7. (3) Journal-issue listing pages /fa/article/journal-number/<id>/... are linked from every result (not needed — the portal search covers them). (4) The results page exposes an Excel export (/fa/article/excel?model=article&query[...]) — not needed, the HTML route suffices. (5) sitemap.xml -> the site's 404 page; robots.txt -> 404 page; OAI-PMH (/oai?verb=Identify) -> 404; RSS (/fa/article/rss) -> 404 — none exposed. (6) Alternate hosts: www.ensani.ir and http://ensani.ir both answer 200 (same site). (7) Index fallbacks (Crossref/DOAJ/OpenAlex -> ensani PDFs) not needed: the portal's own routes passed both bars. History of science (تاریخ علم) is a covered field: the University of Tehran journal «تاریخ علم» was verified on the portal during probing (دوره ۱۹ بهار و تابستان ۱۴۰۰ شماره ۱ پیاپی ۳۰ and پاییز ۱۳۸۲ شماره ۱ appear in portal search results, and a تاریخ علم article's PDF probe-verified above). Candidates carry oa_pdf_url = the download route so attach_fulltexts_v2 fetches the PDF directly.
